t: Easydrive hex bolt coach screws are robust fixings designed for secure timber construction. Ideal for outdoor landscaping projects, decking installations, or securing heavy timber frames where strong, reliable connections are essential. Manufactured from A2 stainless steel, these 10mm x 120mm screws offer excellent corrosion resistance for both indoor and outdoor applications. The bolt head ensures a secure high driving force, while the thread cutting tip and deep coarse thread provide smooth penetration and high pull-out resistance. Partially threaded for strong clamping, pre-drilling is required for optimal performance in wood.
b: Bolt Head for a Secure High Driving Force
Deep Coarse Thread for Secure Fixing & High Pull-Out Resistance
